description: Requests a free competitive brief for a person who has no Debriefing account, and returns a claim URL. Debriefing researches the company and the competitors, and emails the brief to the person. The person opens the claim URL and signs up once, with the same email, to get a workspace that holds the brief. Ask the person first: send person_consented true only after they agree. One email address gets one brief this way; a repeat returns the same claim URL.

company_url.description: The person's company website, such as acme.example

competitor_domains.description: Optional. Competitor domains to research first, such as rival.example

email.description: The person's work email. The brief goes there, and the person signs up with it.

person_consented.description: True only when the person agreed that Debriefing researches their company and emails them the brief.

name: request_free_brief
title: Request a free brief
